title: seal.yaml: the SEAL host configuration
description: What a host declares about one model endpoint running behind the Anyroute sidecar. Checked by deploy/seal/validate.ts and, for the fields it writes, by deploy/seal/install.sh with the same patterns.

host_id.description: The HostBond id (bytes32, 0x and 64 lowercase hex). The installer generates one if none is given; nothing is bonded until you call HostBond.bond yourself.

engine.description: The OpenAI-compatible model server the sidecar sits in front of. Only vllm and sglang have batch-invariant (deterministic) serving modes.

engine_url.description: Where the sidecar reaches the engine (no trailing slash, no /v1).

served_name.description: The model id the engine serves (from its /v1/models).

weights_sha256.description: The Anyroute model digest of the weights directory (bun sidecar/src/main.ts digest <dir>), sha256: and 64 lowercase hex.

tokenizer_sha256.description: SHA-256 of tokenizer.json, sha256: and 64 lowercase hex.

quant.description: Weight format as served, for example bf16, fp8, awq, q4_k_m.

creator_handle.description: Royalty recipient's Hugging Face handle (claims via a signed proof).

royalty_bps.description: Share of token revenue paid to the creator, in basis points.

lanes.description: Lanes this endpoint offers. attested and unlinkable need an Intel TDX host.

tee.description: The CPU trusted execution environment. tdx: Intel TDX (the sidecar attests it directly or through dstack). sev-snp: AMD SEV-SNP (CPU claims only, never GPU). none: no confidential VM.

cc_mode.description: Whether you claim NVIDIA confidential-computing mode. Quote it: YAML 1.1 readers turn a bare on into true.

multi_gpu.description: single: one GPU. nvle: Blackwell encrypted NVLink. ppcie: protected PCIe, NVLink traffic is not encrypted.

region.description: Datacenter region code, for example eu-west.

nodes.description: Serving nodes for this model (seal add-node). Each one runs the same sidecar and engine.

allOf.description: attested and unlinkable lanes need an Intel TDX host.
A confidential-GPU claim needs Intel TDX: SEV-SNP has no runtime measurement register to bind GPU evidence into.
